app.run: The Teachable Machine is a static SvelteKit app (adapter-static); everything lives in the browser (projects in IndexedDB `teachable-calliope`, store `projects`), so there is no backend, database or login. Install with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. In an Obeya workspace, serve the production build: `pnpm build` (about a minute), then `pnpm preview --port <free port> --strictPort` in the background, and open http://localhost:<port>/. Rebuild and restart the preview after every change. Do not use `pnpm dev` there: in dev, vite.config.ts serves calliope-ui and mini-connection-widget from `../../lib/` (the calliope-dev superrepo); outside the superrepo it falls back to the copies in node_modules, whose component styles vite-plugin-svelte does not compile in dev, so the header logo renders full-screen and the page is unusable. Inside the superrepo checkout (D:/GIT/calliope-dev/editors/Teachable-Calliope-Svelte) `pnpm dev --port <port>` works and hot-reloads. The start page (`/`, "Projekt wählen") lists the projects of the browser; for a demo with data, write projects into IndexedDB from the page (objects with id, name, mode 'image' or 'pose', createdAt, updatedAt, classes [], examples {}, classThumbs {}, modelHistory [], currentModelId null), remove localStorage `teachable-last-project-id` and reload. The camera, the Calliope mini (USB/Bluetooth) and MakeCode need hardware or network and are not available in a headless browser. `pnpm build` and `svelte-kit sync` rewrite src/locales/*.js with LF line endings; restore them with `git checkout -- src/locales` before committing unless the change is about translations. Stop the preview afterwards by its PID.
